scenes.text: What if your next long weekend was in the Caribbean? Thursday afternoon at El Dorado: grab your suitcase, we're going!
Just a two-hour direct flight over the clouds, and the sea below starts turning turquoise.
Welcome to Aruba! Sunshine, warm trade winds and palm trees everywhere you look.
Day one: lay your towel on the soft white sand of Eagle Beach, and relax under the famous twisted fofoti trees.
Day two: rent a jeep, it's cheaper than taxis, and explore the wild coast of Arikok National Park all the way to the natural pool.
Day three: snorkel in the calm, crystal clear water of Mangel Halto, full of colorful fish and coral.
In the evening, head up to the California Lighthouse and watch the sky turn pink over the sea.
Sunday afternoon you land back in Bogotá, tanned and happy. And you only took two days off work!
